mechanism: Lopinavir (CYP3A4 inhibitor) increases mefloquine plasma concentrations, elevating risk of neuropsychiatric and cardiac toxicity; mefloquine may also inhibit CYP3A4, creating bidirectional interaction.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if malaria prophylaxis required in HIV patients on lopinavir, consider alternative agents (atovaquone-proguanil or doxycycline) with safer interaction profiles.
